S.FORM: alang Suru ga niya mki sku Byori Keng atu Tayang go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 95 buwan, 292 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 279 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 13 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 94%, Amis 1%, Rukay 0.5%, binah lihuyan s'uli 0.5%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ru kyokay. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Suru hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Suru hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Suru hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Suru hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Suru hya' ga Sakuhan. tay 'llaw na Suru hya' ga Malabang. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ [s|ɕ]uru ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku βjori keŋ atu tajaŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * rukaj ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli ** maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ru kjokaj rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na [s|ɕ]uru ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na [s|ɕ]uru ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na [s|ɕ]uru ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na [s|ɕ]uru ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na [s|ɕ]uru ħjaʔ ɣa [s|ɕ]akuħan taj ʔllaw na [s|ɕ]uru ħjaʔ ɣa malaβaŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
